name: combobox-menu
title: Combobox Menu
description: Combobox Menu — the listbox that opens 4px under a focused Combobox. Content: Results (matches bolded; Focus = highlighted with arrow keys) · Recent (empty query) · Loading (async search, show after 300ms) · No results (say what was typed + what to try) · Create (offer to add the typed value). Show keyboard hint for first-run or power-user surfaces. Max height 320 then scroll; width = field width.
